author: jracer15
body:
Map Name: Medieval Skies
Creators: jracer15
Gamemode: Skywars
Teams: Blue, White, Yellow, Red

When I heard Seth was looking into reviving Skywars back to the servers I wanted to make a map for him to also test since he said we can.  So that brought me Medieval Skies, a medieval themed map with a small castle and small cave.  The small islands have medieval wells with a OPFisherman Rod(Knockback II), and the middle has the sword in the stone theme with a King Arthur Sword(Sharpness 1 and Knockback 1).  When we tested Floating Islands, cannons were a cool idea added to skywars but I know many don't know how to make it so I have the idea for the yml to make bows shoot tnt and I made the map be scarce with arrows so it doesn't become op.  I want to understand the yml use of this Seth so please work with me to better understand this because you did something truly wonderful for the server and I want to help as well!  I added myself to the contest cause why not :p

Map Download: https://www.dropbox.com/s/rop12x5k63t4gcy/MedievalSkies.zip?dl=0
Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/pb4IZ
YML: http://pastebin.com/0ekSmCds
